outputs.explanation: This is a spatial transcriptomics cluster map image (micrograph/spatial plot showing cluster assignments per spot), not a summary plot of averaged data; individual spots are already displayed.
H&E histology images with manual region annotations; not a plot of averaged/aggregated quantitative data.
H&E image plus spatial gene expression heatmap overlays showing per-spot expression levels; these already show individual spot values, not an averaged summary statistic.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots (running enrichment score curves); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Bar graph showing log2 fold change (a derived/averaged value from differential expression analysis) for each gene, with p-values annotated but no individual data points (e.g., per-spot or per-replicate expression values) overlaid on the bars.
